description:
During the end step before your turn, activate The Pandorica by paying {1}{W} and tapping it, phasing out Barren Glory.
Cast Kaervek's Spite by paying {B}{B}{B}, discarding your hand, and sacrificing all permanents.
When The Pandorica leaves the battlefield, Barren Glory phases in.
Resolve Kaervek's Spite, causing an opponent to lose 5 life.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.
